title: Surreal Studio Surveillance
description: A dimly lit, dilapidated artist's studio filled with wooden crates, a hanging burlap sack, and an open doorway. In the foreground, an artist's table holds an open notebook with handwritten notes and a fountain pen, while a security camera points toward the room from beside a monitor displaying a brightly lit gallery opening with well-dressed people viewing paintings.
prompt: A dimly lit and decaying artist's studio with concrete walls and hanging light bulbs. Wooden crates and canvases are stacked around the room. A figure in a blue dress and white mask stands near the left wall. In the foreground, an old wooden table holds an open notebook with visible handwriting and a fountain pen. A security camera is mounted near a monitor on the right showing a bright, crowded art gallery exhibition with people viewing paintings. An open doorway reveals a hanging burlap sack in the background, overall atmosphere is unsettling and surreal.
